authority: T0 exact fixed-regulator interacting driven-circuit and work-transport route split; not a TECT claim, tier change, inherited CL8 dynamics intertwiner, physical-state theorem, CP1 completion, or Pre-A closure
statement: In the explicitly inserted one-dimensional per-unit-transverse-area CL8 reduction, each leg carries the same eight Q3 species and canonical p=(a/8)Pi variables. The complete Q3 onsite polynomial and each nearest-neighbour spatial bond admit an exact two-colour bond-density ledger. A two-leg gate formed from quarter kinetic shears, the exact q-only bond-density kick, a declared full-rank passive controller, and quarter kinetic shears is a global polynomial symplectomorphism with exact mixed inverses on all four orientations. Repeating this gate on every vertex of an open directed rectangle gives a unique, sweep-independent, causal symplectic diffeomorphism from the two incoming arms to every acyclic monotone cut. The ordered drift, polynomial-phase and passive-metaplectic factors give exact interacting forward-cut unitaries on B(H), exact normal-density transport, and an exact sign-indefinite local-to-global oscillator-action work ledger. The periodic even/odd companion assigns the inherited one-dimensional kinetic and Q3/spatial coefficients with no omission, but its inserted controller and ordering make it a new driven Floquet candidate rather than the inherited autonomous CL8 flow or its D-K-D step. Keeping the exact commuting global Q3 kick instead leaves q-only microcuts rank deficient. This closes only the interacting driven work-and-transport subgate; the common-parent dynamics/state/reference gate remains open.
verdict: ADVANCE AN EXACT 1D Q3-DENSITY INTERACTING TWO-ARM ALL-CUT CIRCUIT WITH WORK AND B(H) STATE TRANSPORT; FORMALLY REJECT IDENTIFYING ITS FULL-RANK MICROGATES WITH THE INHERITED CL8 ORDER; KEEP THE COMMON PARENT OPEN

model_scope.selected_branch: the inserted one-dimensional transverse-zero, per-unit-transverse-area CL8 model with w=a/8; not the original three-dimensional ST8/Q3LOCK regulator with weight a^3/8
model_scope.domain: M is even and M>=4, Lambda_M=Z/(MZ), L>0, a=L/M, w=a/8, mu=chi*w, chi>0, c>0, g>0, lambda>0, r real, hbar>0, nonzero microstep tau, and real gamma,eta with gamma^2+eta^2=1 and gamma*eta nonzero
model_scope.leg_variables: q_j in R^8 and canonical p_j=w*Pi_j in R^8; each leg has real phase dimension 16 and every M-leg cut has dimension 16M
model_scope.inserted_controller: the passive mixing G and directed rectangle order are new controller data; they are not derived from H_a, the continuum Goursat equation, a null cone or a cooling history

exact_term_ledger.bond_partition: the even bonds (0,1),(2,3),... and odd bonds (1,2),(3,4),...,(M-1,0) partition the periodic nearest-neighbour edges, and sum_j V_j=U_a exactly; every onsite term has two half-owners and every spatial bond one full owner
exact_term_ledger.kinetic_ownership: as a coefficient-occurrence ledger, with h=tau/4 every node participates in one gate per parity layer and each gate applies an input and output D_h shear, so four h shears per full two-layer period carry total coefficient tau for that node's inherited kinetic term; intervening kicks and controllers prevent combining them into one global exp(-i*tau*T_a/hbar)
exact_term_ledger.controller_ownership: one G gate is recorded on every periodic bond; these M controller insertions are extra terms rather than hidden pieces of T_a or U_a
exact_term_ledger.ordering_boundary: the local V_j kicks commute only when no drift or controller lies between them; the prescribed even-then-odd driven product is not K_(tau*U_a), the inherited D-K-D split, or exp(-i*tau*H_a/hbar)

local_interacting_gate.controller: G maps (Z_W,Z_S) to (gamma*Z_W+eta*Z_S,-eta*Z_W+gamma*Z_S) on complete 16-coordinate legs
local_interacting_gate.gate: F_(tau,V)=(D_h direct-sum D_h) after G after K_(tau,V) after (D_h direct-sum D_h)
local_interacting_gate.temporal_result: every factor and hence F is a global polynomial symplectomorphism of R^32; explicitly F^(-1)=(D_(-h) direct-sum D_(-h)) after K_(-tau,V) after G^T after (D_(-h) direct-sum D_(-h))
local_interacting_gate.mixed_inverse: given pre-drift W and final N, set W1=D_h(W), N1=D_(-h)(N); solve q_S1=(q_N1+eta*q_W1)/gamma and p_S1=[p_N1+eta*(p_W1-tau*V_W)]/gamma+tau*V_S with both gradients evaluated at (q_W1,q_S1); then q_E1=(q_W1+eta*q_N1)/gamma, p_E1=(p_W1+eta*p_N1-tau*V_W)/gamma, S=D_(-h)(S1), and E=D_h(E1); the eta-oriented solve is analogous
local_interacting_gate.cross_determinants: all single-leg drifts have determinant one, while the central opposite-leg projection blocks have determinants gamma^16 or eta^16; therefore every required full-gate opposite-leg projection-block determinant is gamma^16 or eta^16 on the entire field space, independent of the Q3 Hessian; the complete temporal 32-dimensional symplectic map itself has determinant one
local_interacting_gate.orientation: the mixed maps preserve the signed form Omega_first-Omega_second; no same-positive-orientation strict continuous-variable dual-unitarity is claimed

global_open_rectangle.domain: positive integers m,n with m+n=M; west and south arms contain n and m complete legs and share no edge variable at their geometric corner
global_open_rectangle.recurrence: at every vertex (i,j), apply the declared F to the incoming west and south edge legs to obtain the east and north edge legs
global_open_rectangle.constraints: none; the input space is the full nondegenerate 16M-dimensional phase space, its radical is zero, and no ancilla or quotient is introduced
global_open_rectangle.existence_uniqueness: induction on i+j computes every edge; reversing the exact mixed formulas reconstructs the complementary arms globally, not merely locally
global_open_rectangle.sweep_independence: every topological sweep gives the same edge assignment because each vertex has one fixed predecessor pair and ready incomparable vertices act on disjoint unresolved outputs
global_open_rectangle.all_cut_result: each order ideal, equivalently each nonincreasing row-length tuple, defines an M-leg cut; the input-to-cut map is a global polynomial symplectic diffeomorphism and the number of cuts is binomial(m+n,m)
global_open_rectangle.causality: each edge depends only on the finite southwest rectangle of arm inputs; coefficients or derivatives outside it vanish exactly
global_open_rectangle.periodic_boundary: the theorem is for open acyclic rectangles; arbitrary wrapped two-arm seams and monodromy remain unproved

work_branch.reference_action: I_nu(q,p)=sum_legs[nu*||q||^2+||p||^2/nu]/2 for inserted nu>0; its zero is only an additive measurement convention
work_branch.drift_increment: Delta_D I_nu=(nu*h/mu)*q dot p+(nu*h^2/(2*mu^2))*||p||^2 on each leg
work_branch.kick_increment: Delta_K I_nu=-(tau/nu)*(p_W dot V_W+p_S dot V_S)+(tau^2/(2*nu))*(||V_W||^2+||V_S||^2), evaluated after the input drift
work_branch.controller_increment: zero because G is orthogonal on complete equal-nu legs
work_branch.local_ledger: W_v is the sum of the two input-drift increments, the kick increment, and the two output-drift increments evaluated at their actual intermediate states; I_out-I_in=W_v exactly
work_branch.global_ledger: for every order ideal, the sum of W_v over its vertices equals the total I_nu on the target cut minus the total I_nu on the input arms; internal cut contributions telescope and the result is sweep independent
work_branch.sign_boundary: W_v is sign-indefinite and I_nu is not asserted conserved, physical, or equal to H_a; this branch proves work accounting rather than a common positive invariant or stationary state

quantum_forward_cut.Hilbert_space: each leg is L2(R^8), every M-leg cut is canonically L2(R^(8M)), and no oscillator truncation is used
quantum_forward_cut.local_unitary: U_F=(Dhat_h tensor Dhat_h)*Ghat*exp(-i*tau*V(Q_W,Q_S)/hbar)*(Dhat_h tensor Dhat_h), with the single-leg Dhat_h=exp(-i*h*||P||^2/(2*mu*hbar)) and Ghat the passive metaplectic controller
quantum_forward_cut.forward_cut_unitary: the ordered product over the vertices of an order ideal is a unitary U_I from the input-cut Hilbert space to the canonically enumerated target-cut Hilbert space; ready-vertex order does not change the product because ready gates act on disjoint tensor factors
quantum_forward_cut.BH_map: with rho_I=U_I*rho_in*U_I^*, the declared Heisenberg pullback is alpha_I(A_target)=U_I^* A_target U_I; the opposite algebra embedding is iota_I(A_input)=U_I A_input U_I^*, and both are normal star-isomorphisms in their stated directions
quantum_forward_cut.density_transport: rho_I=U_I*rho_in*U_I^* preserves positivity, trace one, trace class and normality exactly for every input density
quantum_forward_cut.work_domain: the symmetrized quantum work identity is asserted as a quadratic-form identity on the common Schwartz core and in expectation only for densities with the required finite polynomial moments
quantum_forward_cut.algebra_boundary: the exact interacting result is on B(H); the nonlinear phase does not normalize the regular Weyl C-star algebra and no direct nonlinear Weyl-generator relabelling is used
quantum_forward_cut.state_boundary: transport is not stationarity, a Gibbs theorem, a physical preference rule or strict dual-unitarity under mixed reshufflings
